meta.notes: USPS retail counter rates. Sellers using eBay-purchased or third-party discounted labels typically pay less than these retail prices, especially for Ground Advantage and Priority Mail -- treat these as an upper-bound estimate, not what you'll actually be charged at checkout. UPS and FedEx are not modeled with real rate tables (their retail/account rates vary too much by dimensional weight, account discounts, and fuel surcharges to responsibly hardcode) -- they're listed as pointers to get a real quote, not computed estimates.

ups_ground.note: UPS Ground retail rates for a 1 lb package commonly run roughly $12-$16 depending on zone, with steep increases by weight and dimensional weight -- not precise enough to hardcode responsibly. Get a real quote at ups.com or from whatever label provider you use.

fedex_home_delivery.note: FedEx Ground/Home Delivery pricing is account- and dimension-dependent, similar to UPS. Get a real quote at fedex.com or from whatever label provider you use.
